next.reason: 1985 b: for any other exception, control is transferred 'according to rules of the USE statement' after the USE procedure, so execution goes on. §2023:14.9.30.4 GR13 keeps a) and c) but b) routes via 9.1.12 (§2023:9.1.12 GR2 for the USE declarative) and continues at the end of READ only 'If the exception condition is not a fatal exception condition'. I-O statuses 3x and 4x are fatal: §2023:9.1.13.1 'The implementor may either continue or terminate the execution of the run unit', and §2023:14.6.13.1.3 GR3 applies the fatal-condition rules. A 1985 program whose USE procedure handles, say, status 30 or 46 can now be terminated. GR13 a) also adds the record-operation-conflict proviso (new locking).
